about_the_game:
Warlords rise. Empires fall. Your destiny is forged in the fires of conquest.

Ashen Destiny is a turn-based strategy epic set in a war-torn land inspired by the Romance of the Three Kingdoms series — a love letter, if you will. Conquer randomized provinces, recruit powerful generals with random stats, and command armies of up to 20 generals per invasion in massive tactical battles.

No two campaigns are ever the same!

🏹 Features:

  • Massive Army Control – Command up to 20 generals at once on beautiful battlefields, each with their own randomly generated stats and your chosen unit types.

  • Randomized World Maps with Different Sizes – Every campaign unfolds across a procedurally generated world filled with unpredictable opportunities and threats.

  • Tactical 3D Battles – Engage in turn-based combat on a grid-based 3D battlefield. Use terrain, troop composition, and positioning to outmaneuver the enemy.

  • Deep Province Management – Control resources like Soldiers, Crops, Food, Horses, Bows, and Arms. Train troops, reward generals, search for hidden talent, and expand your war machine with extra help from mining, trade, and a savvy traveling merchant.

  • Conquest Through Strategy – Every decision matters. Strike with brute force, or outwit rivals through manipulation, diplomacy — or assassination.

Whether you conquer through loyalty or fear, battle or diplomacy, your legacy will be written in blood and ash.

Your warlords await. Your rivals are watching. It’s time to shape your Ashen Destiny.

name: Ashen Destiny

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 370 / Intel Iris Xe
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Steam client to be running.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X or Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 6600 / Nvidia GTX 1660 / RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Steam client to be running.

short_description: Conquer randomized lands in a brutal turn-based strategy epic. Recruit generals with random stats and command massive armies in battle. Forge your legacy through tactical warfare, resource control, and ruthless ambition.
supported_languages:
English*, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
